name: Discrete Transistor — NetTie
description: Cluster of 4 discrete transistor parts featuring NetTie package family footprints in surface-mount and through-hole options.
selection_hints: Choose between surface-mount (SMD) and through-hole (THT) mounting options.
Match the required NetTie-3 footprint pad size ranging from 0.3mm to 2.0mm.
avoid_when: A package family other than NetTie is required by the PCB design.
Footprints outside the provided NetTie-3 SMD and THT pad sizes are needed.
Parts with quality ratings higher than tier C are required.
